inspiration.observed_pattern: Two JSON_TABLE expansions turn comma-separated include and exclude lists into relational rows, then grouped ordered GROUP_CONCAT values are conditionally combined into a report label.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a component-bundle audit. Separate CTEs expand include and exclude code lists, resolve labels, aggregate each side with ordered GROUP_CONCAT, and use CASE/CONCAT to build one deterministic summary per bundle. The source schema, pizza workflow, identifiers, and values are not copied.

fixture_notes: Bundle 701 includes Copper and Glass and excludes Latex. Bundle 702 includes Foam and excludes Metal and Silicone. Bundle 703 has no component codes and must produce an empty summary.
determinism_notes: Bundle IDs, component codes, labels, list order, ordered aggregation, conditional separators, and final ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE component_catalog (component_code VARCHAR(16) PRIMARY KEY, component_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE component_bundles (bundle_id INT PRIMARY KEY, bundle_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, include_codes VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, exclude_codes VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH included AS (SELECT b.bundle_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.component_label ORDER BY c.component_label SEPARATOR ', ') AS included_labels FROM component_bundles AS b INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[\"', REPLACE(b.include_codes, ',', '\",\"'), '\"]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (component_code VARCHAR(16) PATH '$')) AS j ON TRUE INNER JOIN component_catalog AS c ON c.component_code = j.component_code WHERE b.include_codes <> '' GROUP BY b.bundle_id), excluded AS (SELECT b.bundle_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.component_label ORDER BY c.component_label SEPARATOR ', ') AS excluded_labels FROM component_bundles AS b INNER JOIN JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[\"', REPLACE(b.exclude_codes, ',', '\",\"'), '\"]'), '$[*]' COLUMNS (component_code VARCHAR(16) PATH '$')) AS j ON TRUE INNER JOIN component_catalog AS c ON c.component_code = j.component_code WHERE b.exclude_codes <> '' GROUP BY b.bundle_id) SELECT b.bundle_id, b.bundle_name, CONCAT(CASE WHEN i.included_labels IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('Include ', i.included_labels) END, CASE WHEN i.included_labels IS NOT NULL AND e.excluded_labels IS NOT NULL THEN ' - ' ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN e.excluded_labels IS NULL THEN '' ELSE CONCAT('Exclude ', e.excluded_labels) END) AS component_summary FROM component_bundles AS b LEFT JOIN included AS i ON i.bundle_id = b.bundle_id LEFT JOIN excluded AS e ON e.bundle_id = b.bundle_id ORDER BY b.bundle_id

checks.sql: SELECT bundle_id, bundle_name, include_codes, exclude_codes FROM component_bundles ORDER BY bundle_id
